reasons: Every AC in TASK.md maps to at least one assertion node, and trace.json reports all 21 nodes ok.

The recipe reaches the exact screen and state named in the bug report through the manifest-declared UI path only, including an explicit re-selection of the Perps balance so the later token press is a real payment-method transition.
Reverting the fix breaks the run: the pre-fix baseline recipe asserts the opposite values and passes against stashed code, producing the before-evidence side by side with the after-evidence.

Assertions were narrowed to what the runner can actually measure after ui.wait_for expected=visible was proven unusable on this screen; the viewport claim rests on read screenshots instead of a bogus state assertion.
better_version_guidance: If the runner gains a working viewport measurement for React Native host nodes, replace AC2's expected=present assertions with expected=visible so the action-button claim stops depending on a human reading the capture.
Seed a fixed-balance fixture token so the funding message text is deterministic instead of tracking the live ETH balance.

intent_clarity.reason: Every node intent states a trader-visible goal rather than restating its action or selector; the runner's own intent validator rejected two earlier drafts until they did.

coverage.reason: AC1 and AC2 are covered by on-device absence/presence assertions plus a before/after capture; AC3 and AC4 are covered by an assert_exit_code over a focused Jest run, because the unresolved-balance window is a timing-dependent render pass no manifest read action can sample deterministically.

evidence_fit.reason: Visual ACs are proven by PNGs that were read directly, not judged from filenames; state ACs are proven by test exit code and log, not by screenshots of hidden behaviour.

flake_risk.reason: The underlying defect is a timing window. The recipe removes the main source of flake by forcing a real payment-method transition, and its assertions are invariants of the fix (the Perps-balance warning and the zero-available row can never render while a wallet token is selected), so it does not depend on catching the window. The screenshot content can still vary with the fixture token balance.
